why: Restores the header issue #322 came to fix. The store has exactly two scopes -- `lifetime()` and `attempt()`, the latter zeroed on every world build -- and no run-sized tally at all, so this column has never held what it claimed. stats.ts's own doc names this exact string as the ambiguous use of `run` issue #153 asks to remove, which is why the fix is a rename and not a new measurement. Re-anchored when the column was renamed from "Current attempt" to "Level attempt" -- one scope, one name, matching the ending screens. RE-ANCHORED for issue #629, which rebuilt this header row out of <th scope="col"> instead of <td> -- the column names moved but this entry's question did not, so the anchor follows them rather than the entry being retired.
killedBy: hud: the stats page names the two scopes for what they ARE: Lifetime and the current attempt
